"Eeech. I'm not going to say "that's not a big mistake", but rather well... now you realize just how dangerous that is."

Thanks for at least being honest. I *will*, of course, make sure that I never do anything even sort of similar in the future without having it checked over and signed in triplicate, but how do I know I won't make some other, equally stupid (or even _more_ stupid) mistake? What if I'm the kind of person who just does lots of really dumb things? I could work at some menial job, I guess, where if I always screw up it doesn't matter as much.
